profile.name: Jay Kamble
profile.tagline: Full Stack Developer | AI Engineer | SaaS Builder

introduction: Hi, I'm Jay Kamble (JayKamble009), a Full Stack Developer based in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra. I enjoy building useful software that solves real-world problems while continuously learning and creating intuitive, user-focused experiences. I'm currently focused on building scalable web applications and AI-powered SaaS products with an emphasis on performance, clean architecture, and user experience.
journey: I've always been drawn to how things work under the hood. During my B.Sc. in Information Technology at Deogiri College (Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Marathwada University), I realized early on that theory isn't enough. So, instead of just reading textbooks, I spent my time actually building things. Breaking production, fixing bugs, and deploying real full-stack apps with React, Next.js, and Node.js is how I really learned to code.
cta: Currently open to joining innovative engineering teams, undertaking select freelance contracts, or collaborating on high-impact web and AI SaaS products.
